nodes.label: Changelog (Keep a Changelog, SemVer)
nodes.rationale: Written by hand; format follows Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and versions follow Semantic Versioning.

nodes.label: Release 0.1.0: first public release
nodes.rationale: Extracted from a private Home Assistant configuration. Introduces the parlour package (ports, provider registry loading third-party providers from npm, built-in providers ffmpeg, afplay, openWakeWord, whisper.cpp, Kokoro, macOS say, OpenAI-compatible models, Anthropic, SearXNG, Brave; Home Assistant, MCP and connectors integrations), the CLI, the network server, the menu bar app that only drives the CLI, and config moved to ~/.config/parlour/config.json with a provider name in every slot. parlour init converts an old agent.config.json; PARLOUR_TOKEN replaces AGENT_TOKEN (still read this release); /v1/models reports model id parlour.
